description: This file contains a shell script implementing a backend for IPv6-in-IPv4 tunneling using 6to4. It includes functions for setting up and tearing down the tunnel, handling IP address configuration, and validating addresses according to RFC standards, as well as initializing the protocol configuration.

methods.name: find_6to4_prefix
methods.description: Calculates the 6to4 IPv6 prefix based on an IPv4 address.

methods.name: test_6to4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address belongs to private or special-use address ranges as per RFC 1918 and RFC 6598.

methods.name: proto_6to4_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 6to4 IPv6 tunnel with provided configuration.

methods.name: proto_6to4_teardown
methods.description: Tears down or cleans up the 6to4 tunnel configuration.

methods.name: proto_6to4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the 6to4 protocol.
